title: Bit construction (no κ; conditional on #1043): R438 + one transport + optimal window-respecting re-hosting → c = 0.0017348463 (+0.082% vs #589); fixes two #1345 atlas crashes
body:
**Finite conditional bit-supplier construction plus a tool fix. No new κ.** The bit supplier does not bind: complex is 0.0016754627 and κ is 0.0016726602. Everything here is conditional on [#1043](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1043) (Ali Romman's R438 word, helper 470 deleted), which is still open.

| bit endpoint c (exact; accepted at c, rejected at c + 1e-24) | value | vs #1043 |
|---|---|---|
| #589, selected (control) | 0.001733427039589844234749 | |
| #1043 R438, its own in-place hosting (control) | 0.001734176288479865766692 | |
| R438 + one transport, #1043 hosting | 0.001734220472884893243548 | +0.0025% |
| R438, optimal window-respecting re-hosting | 0.001734802047828389852783 | +0.0361% |
| **R438 + transport + optimal re-hosting** | **0.001734846264120199151475** | **+0.0386%** (+0.0819% vs #589) |

**1. One improving transport** (`verify_transport.py`).
- **The move.** A op 2027 (`444 += 77`) moves from frame 186 to slot 154 at frame 79, next to the existing frame-79 reads of source 77. Slots 155 and 425 are equivalent.
- **Effect.** The profile changes by +e1 − 2e2 + e3 at equal mass 5,121. ADDs stay at 24,248, and the 18 multi-source A gates are kept.
- **Checks.**
  - The R438 word rebuilt from #1043's stdlib builder matches #1043's CERTIFICATE and FRAME-PATHS.
  - The new word passes #1043's replay (arbitrary dirty endpoint, precision bounds unchanged) and `xcheck_p.py` (H1–H5, K = D, C = U⁻¹, F2 replay on 660 columns).
- **Local optimality afterwards.** Frameopt finds 0 improving components. The patched atlas finds 0 improving singles and 0 among 442,817 pairs.

**2. Optimal re-hosting of R438's slack** (`verify_rehost.py`).
- **What changes.** Deleting helper 470 leaves 54 width-8 slack units per replica. #1043 folds them back into their own hosts and runs no hosting search.
- **Optimum.** Under #1023's slot model, an exact top-3 interval DP, cross-checked by branch-and-bound over all 10,556,685 layouts, gives a unique optimum: 10 fully idle rank-42 slots plus one 42-slot holding a single helper. The runner-up is worse by Σg 0.0079 per replica, and S = 45 reproduces #589.
- **Windows and placement.**
  - All 22 slack splits are stage-window feasible (maxflow plus a separate Hall test).
  - An explicit placement of 126,144 owner roles passes two audits.
  - There are 29 controls in all.

**3. Two crash bugs in #1345's transport atlas** (`atlas.patch`, 3 lines; `atlas_bugs.py` reproduces them).
- A `dict(..., improving=...)` duplicate-keyword TypeError at line 282, whenever any move improves.
- A `Fraction < tuple` comparison at line 416 (`best[0]` should be `best[0][0]`); line 375 has the same pattern.
- **Effect:** the improving branch was never exercised. On #589's word, the patched and the pristine atlas both reproduce #1345's `result.json`, so its conclusion stands. On R438 the pristine atlas crashes, and the patched one finds the move above.

**Verification.**
- Both deliverables were rebuilt and challenged by adversarial AI verifiers. Their checks covered an independent word rebuild and replay, Decimal endpoint roots, layout counts, the DP optimum and their own mutations; their hygiene findings are fixed.
- Run on CPython 3.14.4. The registered 3.12 replay was not run locally.
- `--check-only` passes, and the research tests pass (65, 2 skipped).

```sh
python3 -I -B research/bit-r438-transport-rehost/verify_transport.py   # PASS_R438_T154_TRANSPORT ... c=...->0.001734220472884893243548 ...
python3 -I -B research/bit-r438-transport-rehost/verify_rehost.py --check research/bit-r438-transport-rehost/verify_rehost.receipt.json   # PASS_R438_WINDOW_REHOST S=54 ...
python3 -I -B research/bit-r438-transport-rehost/atlas_bugs.py         # PASS_PR1345_ATLAS_BUGS ...
```

**Scope.**
- These are local and slot-model certificates, not a supplier admission.
- Not run: #1043's native C++/Boost/NumPy lane (hosted emission, full hosted audit, assemble9, outer). Hosted profiles are assembled as 288·local + 32·remainders.
- Not checked: projector compatibility (#1307) and cross-replica owner maps.
- Not searched: transport triples.
- Base: main `0fdd7d82`. Card `selected-packing`; scope changed to the pending R438 supplier, with the reason in TASK.json.

**Credits.**
- #1043 Ali Romman: R438 word, builder, replay and hosting (vendored).
- #1345 hipotures: transport atlas (vendored, with the fix as a patch).
- #589/#555 lineage.
- #1023: slot model.
- seed72 and seed14 packages: windows, allocation and placement audit.
- #886: frameopt.
- `e8-bit-p111-tuned`: xcheck.
